instruction: Create a PDF file named 'invoice.pdf' from the receipt image at /home/user/OIP.jpg and place it on the desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires converting receipt image to PDF with filename 'invoice.pdf'. Evaluator verifies: (1) File exists at /home/user/Desktop/invoice.pdf, (2) Contains at least 1 embedded image to confirm it's a proper image-to-PDF conversion.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic is semantically correct and can properly verify all instruction requirements
Getter (get_vm_file) correctly fetches the PDF from /home/user/Desktop/invoice.pdf - the exact path specified in the instruction
Metric correctly handles expected parameter: line 33 uses 'expected_state.get('min_images', 1)' which directly accesses the rules dict (correct pattern for type='rule')

PDF validation logic is robust: (1) validates result_state is valid string path, (2) checks file existence, (3) validates PDF structure via PdfReader, (4) counts embedded images by checking '/Subtype' == '/Image' in XObjects across all pages

Coverage is complete: verifies file exists at correct location (/home/user/Desktop/invoice.pdf), has correct filename (invoice.pdf), is a valid PDF, and contains at least 1 embedded image (proving image-to-PDF conversion occurred)
Expected value is semantically correct: min_images=1 is appropriate since instruction requires converting a single receipt image to PDF
Exception handling is appropriate: returns 0.0 for invalid paths, missing files, corrupted PDFs, or any reading errors
No postconfig needed: file system check has no UI state dependencies
Static warnings are false positives: metric DOES read vm_file at line 37 'PdfReader(result_state)' where result_state is the PDF path; static analyzer confused by parameter naming
